credits: Cheat codes by **khuong**. Reformatted for this library; the codes themselves are unchanged.

cheats.name: Master Code
cheats.description: Shared code the other cheats in this set rely on. Installed automatically when any of them is on.

cheats.name: 00. Restore Code (Switch only)
cheats.description: Switch only, for EdiZon/Breeze: puts the game back to normal after you turn cheats off while it runs. Don't turn it on together with other cheats. On emulators, just turn cheats off and restart the game.

cheats.name: 01. Infinite HP
cheats.description: Your party's HP never goes down.

cheats.name: 02. Infinite FP (Flower Points)
cheats.description: Flower Points never go down.

cheats.description: Each enemy gets a random strength boost in this range. Turn on only one of the 03 cheats.

cheats.name: 06. Infinite Item Usage
cheats.description: Using an item doesn't use it up.

cheats.name: 07. 100% Hit Chance
cheats.description: Your attacks never miss.

cheats.name: 08a. Auto Action Commands (Attack)
cheats.description: Attack timing is always perfect. Turn on 08a or 08b, not both.

cheats.name: 08b. Auto Action Commands (Attack and Defense)
cheats.description: Attack and defense timing are always perfect. Turn on 08a or 08b, not both.

cheats.name: 09. Action Gauge Always Full
cheats.description: The Action Gauge stays full.

cheats.name: 10. 999 Chain (After a Successful Chain)
cheats.description: After a successful chain, the chain counter jumps to 999.

cheats.name: 11. Always Escape Battles
cheats.description: Running away from battle always works.

cheats.name: 12a. 100% Item Drop Rate (Normal Drops)
cheats.description: Enemies always drop their normal item. Turn on 12a or 12b, not both.

cheats.name: 12b. 100% Item Drop Rate (Prefer Rare Drops)
cheats.description: Enemies always drop an item, preferring their rare one. Turn on 12a or 12b, not both.

cheats.name: 13. Always Perfect Super & Ultra Jumps (Hold ZR to Stop)
cheats.description: Super Jumps and Ultra Jumps are always timed perfectly. Hold ZR to stop jumping.

cheats.name: 14. Bonus Flower Always Drops
cheats.description: A bonus flower always drops after battle.

cheats.name: 15. Always Special Enemies
cheats.description: Battles always include special enemies.

cheats.name: 19. All Items Cost 0 Coins
cheats.description: Everything in shops costs 0 coins.

cheats.name: 20. Free Purchases (Coins & Frog Coins)
cheats.description: Buying things doesn't take any coins or Frog Coins.

cheats.name: 21. Movement Speed Up
cheats.description: Mario moves faster.

cheats.name: 22. Jump Height Up
cheats.description: Mario jumps higher.

cheats.name: 23a. Ignore Enemy Encounters (On)
cheats.description: Touching enemies on the map doesn't start a battle. Use 23b to switch this back off while playing.

cheats.name: 23b. Ignore Enemy Encounters (Off)
cheats.description: Switches 23a back off (enemies start battles again).

cheats.name: 24. 2x Reward in the Egg Shuffle Game
cheats.description: Double reward in the egg shuffle game.

cheats.name: 25. Midas River: No Fish Hits
cheats.description: The fish in the Midas River barrel ride never hit you.

cheats.name: 26. Auto Yoshi Race
cheats.description: The Yoshi race plays itself.

cheats.name: 27. Goomba Thumping High Score
cheats.description: Sets a high score in the Goomba Thumping minigame.

cheats.name: 28. Add 1 of Every Item (After Buying Anything)
cheats.description: Buying anything adds 1 of every item. Includes key items, which may affect story progress.

cheats.name: 29. All Consumable Items (Check the Storage Box)
cheats.description: Puts every consumable item in the Storage Box at Mario's Pad.

cheats.name: 30a. Force Item Drop (Edit the Item Value)
cheats.description: Every enemy drops the item set by the last code line (00000040 here). Needs 12a or 12b. Item values: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/e/2PACX-1vRbw5pNbLt_aTgJGIZ8Ti1TAnw8aBIa1teZPr8sSyfu_oLQcvluR8R28Cko8R0pcvkMEZWzY-BHpQQV/pubhtml

cheats.name: 30b. Force Item Drop (Off)
cheats.description: Switches 30a back off.

cheats.name: 31. 5 of Every Shared Gear (Use Any Item After)
cheats.description: Gives you 5 of every piece of gear all characters can wear. Use any item afterwards to refresh.
